mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3% signals a tight labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS > 12-month MA, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO YoY < -2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS increases > 50bps, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing real final sales (RSAFS) signals robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are increasing, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a mismatch in labor market dynamics, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when PAYEMS increases and UNRATE rises, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a drop in consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) signals deflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances during a recession when GDPC1 decreases and CPIAUCSL drops, the hypothesis is rejected.
